How Argentina national team connects

  • Character: Lionel Messi — Messi captained Argentina to the 2022 World Cup.
  • Topic: FIFA World Cup — Argentina's World Cup story is Maradona then Messi.

What is Argentina national team?

Argentina won the World Cup in 1978, 1986, and 2022. The last two are personal myths: Maradona in Mexico and Messi in Qatar.
